_doc: IC PRINCIPLED config — May 5 2026. After holdout burn revealed strong-signal IC (score=85/PCR-tight/vol-scaled) was curve-fit to train+val (0 trades fired in 143-day holdout window), this config drops every parameter-tuned filter back to defaults and adds ONLY theory-grounded filters with standard literature thresholds. ADX(14)<22 (Wilder 1978), BB squeeze (Bollinger 1983, percentile-based so no parameter to tune), RV/IV<0.80 (premium-selling alpha source). User direction: don't overfit; use proven indicators with standard thresholds.
